originality.rationale: The exact n=3 RP2 subgroup quotient is published and explicitly excluded from novelty. Prior all-m,n full graph-automorphism disk quotients do not determine the intermediate proper-C3 orbit space, while integer configuration homology and ordered full-symmetry modules do not imply a space-level nonfree quotient homotopy splitting. Actual targeted record searches and the full text of the most plausible three primary related records were compared by implications. No covering all-n law was found; an unindexed equivalent remains a risk.
residual_risks: The exact n=3 base case is already covered by the K3,3 all-subgroups surface census and is not claimed new.
An equivalent uniform n>=4 theorem could exist outside indexed and accessible material; the search is not exhaustive.
Some older graph-braid literature may discuss special cyclic quotients without expressing the resulting space as an RP2 wedge.
